Get a list of your activity logs to track actions within your account. Logs, available for the previous 60 days, can shed light on activities on your account. Please note that we provide up to 50 log messages per page in our responses.

info.name: Get List of Available Account Add-ons

items.docs: Access a comprehensive list of add-ons available for your account. These add-ons offer the flexibility to enhance your plan with extra sites, increased site visits, and additional storage capacity. More details about upgrading your account can be found in our related knowledge base article.
